LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Say_6: I came through {TOWN} on the way here, and you'll want to hear this.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Told_3: {X_nameDef} of the {CAMP} had news of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, and told it to {A_nameDef} over their fire: {NEWS}
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_Told_4: The {CAMP} came by way of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, and {X_nameDef} passed the news on to {A_nameDef}: {NEWS}
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_situation_3: In {TOWN} everyone is talking about {WHAT}, and little else.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_situation_4: {WHAT} is all anyone in {TOWN} wanted to talk about.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_war_3: {PEOPLE} are at war with {ENEMY} now, and {TOWN} is bracing for it.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_war_4: War has come between {PEOPLE} and {ENEMY}, and nobody in {TOWN} talks of anything else.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_peace_3: {PEOPLE} and {ENEMY} have put their war away, and {TOWN} breathes easier for it.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_peace_4: The war between {PEOPLE} and {ENEMY} is over, and {TOWN} is glad of it.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_new_3: {TOWN} is a new town of {PEOPLE}, raised only this year.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_new_4: There is a town called {TOWN} now, where there was none last year, and {PEOPLE} built it.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_site_3: Out to the {DIR} of {TOWN} there is {SITE}, the travelers there say.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_site_4: The people of {TOWN} speak of {SITE}, out to the {DIR}.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_quest_3: {PEOPLE} are asking every traveler through {TOWN} about "{QUEST}", and nobody has taken it on yet.
LanguageData.CC_FarNews_quest_4: There is work going in {TOWN}, "{QUEST}", if anyone wants it.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_4: That's a camp's smoke to the {DIR}, and nobody we know.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_5: There are fires to the {DIR} that weren't there before.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_Visitor_3: Mind the road to the {DIR}, there's a {KIND} out there.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Say_Visitor_4: We passed a {KIND} to the {DIR}, and didn't stop.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_RaidText_4: {PEOPLE} have left their {KIND} {WHERE}, armed and coming this way.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_RaidText_5: From their {KIND} {WHERE}, {PEOPLE} are coming for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Beaten_3: The {KIND} of {PEOPLE} sent {SIZE} against the colony, and {DOWN} of them fell or were taken before the rest gave up.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Beaten_4: The colony held against the raid from the {KIND} of {PEOPLE}: of the {SIZE} who came, {DOWN} fell or were taken.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_HeldOn_3: {MEANS}: most of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, has gone, but a few families stayed behind, and {PEOPLE} have let them keep it.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Empty_4: {MEANS}: there is nobody left in {TOWN}, {WHERE}. {PEOPLE} have gone, and {RUIN} is all that stands there.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Faded_4: {MEANS}: the land has taken back the ruin of {TOWN}, {WHERE}, and only those who knew it could find it now.
LanguageData.CC_RiseFall_Daughter_3: {MEANS}: families from {MOTHER} have struck out on their own and founded {TOWN} of {PEOPLE}, {WHERE}, {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Closed_Sacked_3: {POST}, the {KIND} {PEOPLE} kept {WHERE}, has been sacked by raiders of {ENEMY}, and {PEOPLE} will not open it again. Nothing is left there but {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Closed_Soured_3: {PEOPLE} have given up on {POST}, their {KIND} {WHERE}, with nothing mended between them and {COLONY}. Nothing is left there but {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Closed_War_3: {POST}, the {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE}, is closed: no people keeps a post open for those it is at war with. Nothing is left there but {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Razed_3: {COLONY} razed {POST}, the {KIND} {PEOPLE} had opened to trade with it, and {PEOPLE} will remember it.
LanguageData.CC_Post_Sacked_Text_3: Raiders of {ENEMY}, at war with {PEOPLE}, have come down on {POST}, their {KIND} {WHERE}, and taken all they could carry. The post still stands, but it will trade poorly for a long while.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Help_Food_3: The first fields at {HAMLET} have failed them, and {LEADER} asks whether the colony could spare {GOODS}, carried down to their carter at the gate, to see the families through.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Help_Doctor_3: Sickness has reached {HAMLET}, and {LEADER} has nobody who can treat it. Would the colony's doctor take {GOODS} down to their carter at the gate, and tell them how to use it?
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Help_Tools_3: {HAMLET} is running short of everything {WORD} needs this season, and {LEADER} asks for {GOODS}, carried down to their carter at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_Refused_3: {LEADER} takes the colony's answer back to {HAMLET}: this time they will manage alone.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_NotYet_3: {LEADER} will ask again, when the colony is ready to take {HAMLET}'s oath.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_End_Broken_3: {HAMLET} asked the colony for help twice this season, and was refused both times. Its people have stopped counting on the colony's protection, and the tie between them is broken. {HAMLET} goes on as a town of {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_Hamlet_End_Failed_3: The families of {HAMLET} are leaving. Its people have given up the hamlet the colony took under its protection.
